notes.text: Diocletian, nicknamed Jovius, was Roman emperor from 284 until his abdication in 305.
Diocletian was born Diocles to a family of low status in the Roman province of Dalmatia.
After the deaths of Carus and his son Numerian on a campaign in Persia, Diocles was proclaimed emperor by the troops, taking the name "Diocletianus".
The title was also claimed by Carus's surviving son, Carinus, but Diocletian defeated him in the Battle of the Margus.
Diocletian is remembered as a politician connected with Croatia.
